persons.name: Kṛṣṭivīra
persons.evidence: kṛṣṭīvirana coyā, nāsanani, daṣinadisāsa vohma kliṣṭivirayā, mana ichyā juyāo coyāgu jula

date.as_written: subha saṃvat 984 sāla miti vaisāṣa sukrayā aṭami loja 6 sa raonanakṣatra, subhajoga, sukravāra

notes: The scribe copied the text for himself out of his own desire (mana ichyā juyāo). His name is spelled both kṛṣṭīvira and kliṣṭivira.
